data.long_meaning: Zahan is a Hindu name for boys, derived from the combination of the words 'Surya' meaning Sun and 'Chand' meaning Moon. It is a name that represents the balance of the sun and the moon, the yin and yang of the universe. The name Zahan carries the meaning “Sun, Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Zahan usually hope their child will grow to embody sun, moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Zahan is a powerful spiritual name that signifies the union of the masculine and feminine energies within an individual. It is a name that encourages inner harmony and stability.
data.etymology: Zahan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun, Moon.”

The name Zahan is a reminder of these powerful dualities and the balance they bring to the universe.
